EnvironmentVariable minimum setter adds 1 to input value

#### Description

When setting the minimum value on an EnvironmentVariable, the setter incorrectly adds 1 to the provided value instead of storing it directly.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import cantools

# Load a database with environment variables
db = cantools.database.load_file('tests/files/emc32.dbc')

# Get an environment variable
env_var = db.environment_variables[0]

# Set minimum value
env_var.minimum = -180

# Check the actual stored value
print(f"Expected: -180, Actual: {env_var.minimum}")
```

The output shows that when setting minimum to -180, the actual stored value becomes -179.
</issue>
